_comment: Hand-curated (2026-10-02). Québec river-descent maps, permission-gated: a map reaches the catalog only when its publisher's permission.status is "granted" with quoted evidence (see src/core/catalog/riverMaps.ts). Nothing here is granted yet, so fetch-quebec-rivers.ts writes no fragment and the published catalog is unchanged. Research, licences and outreach drafts: docs/research/quebec-river-maps.md. Bboxes come from each file's own GeoPDF /GPTS, read on 2026-10-02.
